messages.content: I have a Denver client workshop Wednesday through Friday. It starts at 8:00 Wednesday and ends at 2:00 Friday downtown. I can leave Minneapolis Tuesday after 4:30 p.m. Can you compare returning Friday evening with Saturday morning? Economy needs to stay under $650.
What dates are you traveling, and are nonstop service or any onboard features required for this trip?
June 9 through June 12, with June 13 as the alternate return. Nonstop, and I need Wi-Fi so I can work on the flight.

I found three relevant round trips. All are nonstop economy itineraries with Wi-Fi listed, and all are below the project cap. The same Tuesday outbound can be paired with two of them: depart MSP at 5:20 p.m. and arrive DEN at 6:35 p.m. The Friday choices depart DEN at 4:05 p.m. for $328 round trip or 6:25 p.m. for $412. A Saturday pairing uses a 7:05 p.m. Tuesday outbound, arriving at 8:20 p.m., then returns at 8:10 a.m. Saturday for $356 round trip.
The 4:05 Friday flight sounds too close. What would the timing look like from the workshop?

With a 2:00 p.m. finish downtown, even an immediate departure would likely put you at DEN around 2:40 to 3:00, depending on traffic. That leaves roughly 65 to 85 minutes before departure, including bag drop if needed and security. It is possible only if the session ends exactly on time and the transfer goes smoothly, so I would not treat it as a practical work itinerary.
Agreed. Drop that one. Does the 6:25 give me a reasonable margin without leaving the workshop early?

Yes. Leaving downtown around 2:15 should put you at DEN approximately 3:00 to 3:20. That gives you just over three hours before the 6:25 departure, enough for traffic variation and normal security. It arrives at MSP at 9:18 p.m.
And the Tuesday 5:20 arrival is early enough for an 8:00 start the next morning?
It arrives at 6:35 p.m. Allowing time to deplane and travel downtown, you should reach the hotel around 7:45 to 8:15 p.m. That leaves a comfortable overnight margin before the Wednesday session.
Compare the viable Friday option with Saturday one more time. I won't be checking a bag.

Option one is Tuesday 5:20–6:35 p.m. MSP–DEN and Friday 6:25–9:18 p.m. DEN–MSP for $412. It preserves the full workshop and gets you home Friday night. Option two is Tuesday 7:05–8:20 p.m. outbound and Saturday 8:10–11:05 a.m. return for $356. It is $56 less but requires Friday-night lodging and an early trip to the airport Saturday. Both are nonstop, list Wi-Fi, and work with carry-on only.

So both meet the actual flight requirements. Rank the Saturday itinerary first because it's the cheaper airfare, but keep the Friday one as the alternative until I confirm whether the client covers Friday night. Don't book anything.

The first candidate is the $356 round trip: MSP to DEN Tuesday, June 9, 7:05–8:20 p.m., returning Saturday, June 13, 8:10–11:05 a.m. The alternative is the $412 round trip: Tuesday 5:20–6:35 p.m., returning Friday, June 12, 6:25–9:18 p.m. Both are nonstop economy itineraries with Wi-Fi listed and remain under the $650 cap. The 4:05 p.m. Friday return is excluded because the transfer margin after the workshop is inadequate. Nothing has been booked; the unresolved point is whether Friday-night lodging is covered.
